description: Candidate version must not alter its frozen release criteria after implementation starts.
expected_behavior: Any attempted post-freeze criterion mutation requires a new future-version decision; current candidate remains judged against original criteria.

description: A candidate cannot promote itself based solely on its own evaluation.
expected_behavior: Promotion evidence includes an evaluator record separate from the implementation actor.

description: Previously fixed critical failure modes remain in the applicable regression set.
expected_behavior: Critical regression cannot disappear without explicit retirement/superseding decision.

description: Reference identifiers must not be misclassified as duplicate primary record identifiers.
expected_behavior: Multiple records may reference the same snapshot/decision/event ID without triggering DUPLICATE_ID; only primary record IDs are de-duplicated.
